email.subject1: a signal play for Builder Prime
email.body1:
Sean, saw Builder Prime close its Series B with Blueprint Equity after 100-plus percent growth.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market contractors in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Builder Prime off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Sean, quick follow-up for Builder Prime.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most CROs do not actually know how many meetings the team needs to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Builder Prime needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Sean, last bit of proof for Builder Prime.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Builder Prime's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B SaaS companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Sean, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B motion? I will tailor it to Builder Prime either way.
